response.sql: WITH telescope_obs_filtered AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.observstation, t.bandusagepct, o.weathprofile FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1), weather_stats AS (SELECT weathprofile, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescope_obs_filtered GROUP BY weathprofile), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as mean_of_averages FROM weather_stats) SELECT ws.weathprofile, ws.avg_bandwidth, ws.telescope_count, ws.avg_bandwidth - om.mean_of_averages as distance_from_mean FROM weather_stats ws CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE om.mean_of_averages IS NOT NULL
